response_text:
Yes. **DonorDock does include built-in online giving**.

Key details from DonorDock’s own materials:

- DonorDock offers **unlimited online giving pages** tied to campaigns, funds, or events.[4][8]  
- It provides **free online giving pages** as part of its pricing bundles.[5]  
- You can **accept donations online** via credit cards, ACH, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal, using Stripe and PayPal as processors.[1][4][6]  
- Online giving pages are **customizable** (branding, images, text) and support **recurring giving**.[1][3][4]  
- Pages can be **embedded on your website**, shared via **link**, **QR code**, or **text-to-donate keyword**.[1][2]  

So if your question is whether DonorDock can handle online donations directly: **yes, it has a full online giving feature set built in.**
